notes.title: Patch Note | v1.0.5.270558
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,
Our second patch for Ad Infinitum is finally here! All changes are available below.
[i]Please note some fixes are hidden as not to spoil the story. Reveal them at your own risks![/i]

[h2]Global:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Texts now stay on screen for a longer time
[*] Tweaked the Hungers' animations so they do not sync.
[*] Trenches - Locked doors in the bunker can't be opened anymore.
[*] House - Performance increase.
[/list]
[h2]Chapter Specific:[/h2]
[h3]Chapter 1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] House - Drastically changed the light at the end of the Seance Trench.
[*] House - The letter in the bathroom now had the correct text on it.
[*] Trenches - The exploration music stops correctly.
[*] Trenches - You cannot open locked doors in the Command-Bunker.
[*] Trauma Domain - Performance increase.
[*] Ruins - Performance increase when entering the Hunger Area.
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 2:[/h3]
[list]
[*] House - Changed visual asset for the Urn of Katharina von Schmitt.
[*] Trauma Domain - [spoiler]Music when triggering the bad ending sequence with Greater Horror Corruption now plays correctly[/spoiler]
[*] Trauma Domain - Reloading a save made after the intro cutscene and using the lever won't skip the boss fight.
[*] Trauma Domain - Opening the in-game menu won't pause the custscene's music.
[*] Trauma Domain - High Shadow Settings of Hook-Lights won't cause LOD popping.
[*] Trenches - [spoiler]Rage gets properly stunned if it charges back towards the player after spawning.[/spoiler]
[*] Trenches - [spoiler]The player cannot get stuck underneath Rage.[/spoiler]
[*] Trenches - [spoiler]Rage won't stay idle close to the player if they entered a tight spot.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 3:[/h3]
[list]
[*] House - Limited atmosphere's volume in Wintergarden.
[*] House - Fixed the "exit basement" objective.
[*] Attic - The ladder in the attic now works.
[*] Lazarett - Doors now make the correct sounds.
[*] Lazarett - Music in Lazarett now triggers.
[*] Lazarett - The telephone in the waiting room will keep ringing.
[*] [spoiler]Trauma Domain - Music from the QTE with Thanatos will keep playing when opening in-game menus.[/spoiler]
[*] Trauma Domain - Bossfight music now stops when dying.
[*] Trauma Domain - Speaker events now stop when finishing the boss fight and starting cutscenes.
[*] Trenches - Fixed improper camera gliding when shooting at Greater Horror Pain.
[*] Trenches - Fixed sound loop when player got grabbed by Greater Horror Pain
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 4 (spoiler heavy):[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Good Ending - Fixed player footsteps being heard after hugging the Shadow until the next level was loaded.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Endings ME - Johannes Voicelines won't play over the Father/Shadow poem when facing the dead father in the office.[/spoiler]
[/list]
If you have encountered any bug, please let us know, we always keep an eye on our social media, including the Steam Community Hub. More fixes are in the work, so keep an eye out!

notes.title: Patch Note | v1.0.4.270196
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We want to thank you for your feedback on Ad Infinitum, and for your patience.
This first patch addresses a copious amount of issues the community made us aware of, and other bugs we found on the way.

Below is a full list of what's been fixed in this update. Please note some fixes are hidden as not to spoil the story. Reveal them at your own risks!

[h2]Global:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Main Menu - Postprocessing Settings are now saved correctly (FOV, Motion Blur).
[*] Achievements - "Their Names" and "Awaiting Orders" are fixed.
[*] Subtitles - Disabling subtitles will still provide important clues.
[*] House - Bird sounds now stop playing when leaving Mother's Room.
[/list]
[h2]Chapter Specific:[/h2]
[h3]Chapter 1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] House - Corrected nonsensical text in French.
[*] House - Fixed Gramophone Music in Basement.
[*] House - Correct voice line will be played at the telephone, 
[*] House - Players won't get stuck in Paul's Room after waking up because the door wasn't working.
[*] [spoiler]Trenches - The Gas-Field before entering the Morse code Bunker has been fixed, now preventing players to skip the Hunger encounter.[/spoiler]
[*] Trenches - Fixed LOD Popping issues in the Trenches chapter.
[*] Trenches - You can no longer get stuck in squeeze spaces while walking around Hungers after they swarmed the Morse Code Bunker.
[*] [spoiler]Trenches - Morse code Device light no longer indicates 37 instead of 27.[/spoiler]
[*] Ruins - Improved guidance to the Rifle.
[*] [spoiler]Ruins - Made Nyx more visible when entering marketplace.[/spoiler]
[*] Ruins - Player can't walk through a big hole in a wall with a floating brick; this was not intended.
[*] [spoiler]Trauma Domain - Players no longer get catapulted out of bounds.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Trauma Domain - Fixed music not playing from the speaker when interacting with the last button at the Gramophone Pole.[/spoiler]
[*] Adjusted the Hunger behaviour to prevent them from jumping over the Morse code table wall and grabbing players too frequently while in squeeze spaces.
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 2:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lazarett - Door unlocks after respawning.
[*] House - Addressed a blocker in the attic that persisted after reloading a checkpoint.
[*] House - Music no longer pauses when picking up a note.
[*] House - Correct sounds now play when unlocking and opening the safe.
[*] [spoiler]Trenches - Players no longer get trapped with Rage.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Trauma Domain - Voice Memory of the letter in TDE now stops.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Trauma Domain - Music of Bossfight with Erebus didn't increment and got stuck in the first loop.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 3:[/h3]
[list]
[*] House - The telephone close to the attic now stops ringing.
[*] [spoiler]Trenches - Exploration music won't overlap into the plane cutscene.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Trauma Domain - Fixed voicelines in French coming from speakers that were heard everywhere due to wrong spatialization settings.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Trauma Domain - Thanatos grab and camera were broken during Bossfight.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h3]Chapter 4 (spoiler heavy):[/h3]
[list]
[*] [spoiler]All Endings - Voice Atmos on objects now stop, such as the letter of the mother.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Good Ending - Voice Atmos of discharge papers now stop.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Madness Ending - Fixed wooden door sound when interacting with the prison door.[/spoiler]
[/list]
If you have encountered any bug, please let us know, we always keep an eye on our social media, including the Steam Community Hub. More fixes are in the work, so keep an eye out!

notes.title: Ad Infinitum Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847462/202fc3ab6b4c2784af4330565c089fdccb178541.png[/img]
During tonight's Nacon Connect livestream, we showcased the first look at gameplay from in quite a while and announced the release date for Ad Infinitum. 

We've come a long way since we started working on the student project that would eventually become Ad Infinitum. It's been a hell of a journey, and we can't wait to share the nightmarish results with you on April 20th, 2023!

Until then check out our latest trailer and we'll see you in the trenches!
